notes: Unity Ludum Dare 41 entry Rider Quest, a comedic NES-style JRPG mixed with overworld car driving (turn-based battles plus a driveable overworld). Includes BattleManager/Player/Enemy/Car/MessageManager scripts and scenes for overworld, battle, dungeons, houses, dream, and gameover. MIT (copyright 2018 mp-pinheiro). README states code is MIT and artistic work (sounds and music) are CC; Credits.txt lists OpenGameArt tiles/sprites (many CC-BY-SA LPC assets by Lanea Zimmerman/Sharm, Tuomo Untinen, and others). Bundled Tiled2Unity importer is MIT (copyright 2014 Sean Barton / seanba.com); maps authored in Tiled. Playable release noted on GitHub Releases. No EXE/DLL/LFS/Mannequin/InsertPack/StarterContent/EmojiOne/TMP assets/AssetStore. ~73MB src snapshot.
